meta_description: The governed data estate every intelligence program silently depends on.

blocks.x: Fleet Management System — Overview delivered as an operating capability for the enterprise, not a slide deck — durable runtime, policy-checked actions, and telemetry your auditors can read without translation.

Fleet Management System operationalizes the lakehouse: medallion pipelines with data contracts, Unity Catalog-class governance, lineage and freshness SLAs, streaming and batch in one estate, and the AI-ready layer (feature stores, vector search, retrieval services) built on the same governed data. It is the substrate tower made product.

Forge is deliberately boring where it matters: schema contracts enforced at boundaries, expectations tested on every pipeline, cost telemetry per workload, and audit exports regulators can read. Teams inherit reliability as a measured property — and GenAI programs inherit a corpus that doesn't rot.
